body:
The Audit settings page now uses the requested short authority/privacy warning and explicit **Axiom / Custom** choices. Axiom requires a dataset; Custom omits it. Both use Bearer authentication.

The panel fills the shared page width, up to 1,200 pixels. Save and gray secondary Test sit beside each other at natural widths and wrap when a narrow screen cannot fit them. Members keeps its layout. Native Save/Test behavior, encrypted credentials, tenant and revision checks remain intact.

[Desktop preview](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/010c3391853d25de98313b264b35a6bfc362e8cd/ast-report/audit-destination-layout/green-1440.png) · [Mobile preview](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/010c3391853d25de98313b264b35a6bfc362e8cd/ast-report/audit-destination-layout/green-390.png)

Existing None-auth rows stay readable, but every form Save—including disable—and Test need an explicit Bearer upgrade. Old open forms must be reloaded.

## Review

**T1 Team review** — Architecture: **T0: no architecture fact**. The separate reason is `impact.sensitiveBehavior`: the complete candidate changes the credential form and its page-specific script permission.

Architecture facts (candidate [17085397](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/17085397bb0ce9af62d69bffe6a314513f277f7f) against [a7411fd0](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/a7411fd02aa6dd3300b334d4585f71469071b499)):

- None. All 48 public declaration snapshots and all 13 registry diagrams are unchanged.

The [impact declaration](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/17085397bb0ce9af62d69bffe6a314513f277f7f/.pr-impact.json) records one existing web owner mapping the selector into the current dataset field. Production architecture is unchanged; no service, storage, sender, dependency, container or deployment change is needed. The active plan describes the revised form and layout.

**Merge status: blocked pending independent owner/team approval of this exact candidate.** Selected test/build gates passed, including the Linux AMD64 image. Retained quality findings are documented; the checker has zero technical blockers. No prior approval is reused.

## Quality review

**T1 Team review**, candidate **17085397bb0ce9af62d69bffe6a314513f277f7f** against **a7411fd02aa6dd3300b334d4585f71469071b499**. Generated architecture reason: **T0: no architecture fact**. The sole tier reason is `impact.sensitiveBehavior` for the complete candidate's credential form and static-script permission. The layout follow-up adds no new sensitive behavior. [Final checker](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/010c3391853d25de98313b264b35a6bfc362e8cd/ast-report/audit-destination-layout/check-final.json) · [Bound impact](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/010c3391853d25de98313b264b35a6bfc362e8cd/ast-report/impact.json) · [Full manager review](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/010c3391853d25de98313b264b35a6bfc362e8cd/ast-report/audit-destination-layout/quality-notes.md).

No architecture facts, policy questions, new dependencies, metric exceptions, skipped/todo tests, or forbidden edges. The informational note **48 public modules, 0 snapshots changed** is verified. The page and parser are paired inside web; no separate supported client protocol changes, so `contract=false` remains appropriate.

**Quality disposition.** The final process completes all stages: Delta/Review goal misses, CRAP/Architecture passed. Raw exit 1 is retained honestly; there is no tool failure. The layout adjustment leaves all scores and findings unchanged. [Full process](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/010c3391853d25de98313b264b35a6bfc362e8cd/ast-report/process.md) · [Machine process](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/010c3391853d25de98313b264b35a6bfc362e8cd/ast-report/process.json) · [Review findings](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/010c3391853d25de98313b264b35a6bfc362e8cd/ast-report/review.json) · [CRAP](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/010c3391853d25de98313b264b35a6bfc362e8cd/ast-report/crap.json).

- Existing `logging-form.ts`: MI 69.5→65.7. Keep the short CSRF-first boundary and explicit refusal guards. Complexity 13→16 is retained; 100% coverage gives CRAP 16, below the changed-function limit of 30. A private selector predicate adds indirection for two fixed cases; 15 is mandatory only for new functions.
- Existing `logging-page.ts`: MI 72.6→69.0. Keep form markup, labels and field dependencies together. CRAP 8 at 98.5% coverage.
- Existing `members-page-layout.ts`: MI 83.0→81.0. Keep markup and matching CSP hashes with one owner; Members retains script denial. CRAP 7 at 99.8% coverage.
- `members-style.ts` is constant CSS, with no measured function/MI. Real-browser geometry and visual review cover the change.
- High test-only finding: `logging-form.test.ts` MI 54.4→46.5. Keep readable invalid-form scenario tables; tests have no production MI goal. No production-file drop reaches five. No new production file or changed function needs an exception.

Habit-hooks: raw exit 1, the same 30 retained findings, snooze `[]`. One form-complexity finding is covered above. Twenty-four test non-null assertions identify required DOM/headers/routes; missing values fail tests. Four comments explain the legacy tenant name, CSP ownership, or evidence boundaries. The long acceptance file is one cohesive settings-page specification. [Each retained reason](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/010c3391853d25de98313b264b35a6bfc362e8cd/ast-report/audit-destination-layout/quality-notes.md#habit-hooks) links the original per-file assessment. The follow-up adds no finding.

Independent and manager review found no defect. The panel fills the shared content width and its scoped rule leaves Members unchanged. Save/Test keep their native submit behavior. Test contrast is 8.52:1 normally and 6.34:1 on hover; focus remains visible. The row wraps safely on narrow screens. No new script or abstraction was added.

Legacy None rows need a Bearer upgrade for every form Save, including disable, and before Test. This previously reviewed compatibility limit remains explicit. Existing Bearer tokens can stay blank only for the same endpoint. No legal-document bytes, agreements, or production settings changed.

[Base registry](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/a7411fd02aa6dd3300b334d4585f71469071b499/architecture/components.md) · [Candidate registry](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/17085397bb0ce9af62d69bffe6a314513f277f7f/architecture/components.md) · [Assessment](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/010c3391853d25de98313b264b35a6bfc362e8cd/ast-report/audit-destination-layout/architecture-review.json).

All 13 Mermaid blocks are byte-identical. Context, hosted containers, Audit settings/delivery, System/Audit ownership, runtime and deployment stay accurate. No component, relationship, public declaration, container or deployment change; no L3 drawing is needed. The strongest changed callable detail is the private layout's optional static-script argument. Ownership and the fixed-content/exact-hash notes explain its Audit-only use; no L4 diagram adds needed information. This follow-up changes only CSS and a form wrapper.

Unit-only architecture bands retain unknown/unchanged-function limits. Base CRAP derived with head coverage is an estimate. The embedded script string is not a separate TypeScript AST function; VM and Chromium proofs cover it. Browser fixtures do not prove live production authentication or delivery.

</details>
